profile.headline: SWE @ GM | DS @ UMich
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer, data scientist, and computer science graduate experienced in a range of programming languages, tools, and methodologies. Pursuing Master of Applied Data Science at the University of Michigan. Adaptable, self-motivated, and passionate about building things that help people.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Global Engineering Operations
positions.description: Design and implement robust domain-driven solutions that modernize product engineering

positions.title: Data Scientist - 12V Big Data Analytics
positions.description:
Transformed petabyte-scale telemetry data into actionable insights for engineers and leaders across the enterprise

- Developed and productionized VIN-level telemetry visualization app, cutting request wait time from ~6 hours to ~5 seconds for 400+ engineers and cross-functional business stakeholders
positions.insights: Azure Databricks, Apache Spark and +5 skills

positions.title: Data Scientist - Global Engineering Operations
positions.description:
Designed advanced analytics solutions, collaborating across manufacturing, telematics, and regulatory domains

- Led development of manufacturing analysis application with $3.3M+ projected scrap and labor cost savings within first three years
- Built RAG system to verify technical manual compliance with company standards
positions.insights: Apache Spark, Azure Databricks and +23 skills

positions.title: Team Lead - Autonomy
positions.description:
Led team of 20+ undergraduate engineers adding level-4 autonomy to a Chevy Bolt EUV for AutoDrive Challenge II, a 4-year intercollegiate competition established by SAE International and General Motors

- Won 1st place in vehicle integration and overall static events including concept design report/presentation, 3rd place overall
positions.insights: Autonomous Vehicles, Python (Programming Language) and +14 skills

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
- Fine-tuned YOLOv7 (You Only Look Once) object detection models for traffic light state classification
- Developed edge-deployed multi-sensor fusion pipeline integrating camera, LiDAR, GNSS, HD maps, and CAN bus data
positions.insights: Computer Vision, Robot Operating System (ROS) and +7 skills

positions.title: Freelance Photographer
positions.insights: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Lightroom and +7 skills
